spoken: PayPal may retire its old copy and paste buttons after January first, twenty twenty seven. This is Last Button.
written: PayPal may retire its old copy-and-paste buttons after January 1, 2027. This is Last Button.

spoken: Paste a site's address. It finds the old buttons, A I rebuilds each one as a PayPal Payment Link, and a test buyer proves every link takes a payment.
written: Paste a site's address. It finds the old buttons, AI rebuilds each one as a PayPal Payment Link, and a test buyer proves every link takes a payment.

spoken: Here's a community theatre site from twenty ten. Its ticket, T-shirt and raffle buttons were pasted from PayPal years ago, and two of them are saved or encrypted, so the price isn't even in the code. The owner isn't a developer. They just paste the address.
written: Here's a community theatre site from 2010. Its ticket, T-shirt and raffle buttons were pasted from PayPal years ago, and two of them are saved or encrypted, so the price isn't even in the code. The owner isn't a developer. They just paste the address.

spoken: Nine buttons found, seven may stop working. Readable buttons are copied field by field. For the hidden season pass, Gemini reads the page, and it has to quote the page word for word, or its answer is thrown away. Donate and Subscribe aren't affected, so they're left alone. Anything the A I priced waits for one click.
written: Nine buttons found, seven may stop working. Readable buttons are copied field by field. For the hidden season pass, Gemini reads the page, and it has to quote the page word for word, or its answer is thrown away. Donate and Subscribe aren't affected, so they're left alone. Anything the AI priced waits for one click.

spoken: The A I only fills gaps, with structured output, a schema check and a fallback model. It never sets a price on its own.
written: The AI only fills gaps, with structured output, a schema check and a fallback model. It never sets a price on its own.

spoken: One click creates a PayPal Payment Link for each product, with the same sizes, per-size prices, postage and tax. Here's the T-shirt on PayPal's own page: X L at twenty one dollars, plus four fifty postage.
written: One click creates a PayPal Payment Link for each product, with the same sizes, per-size prices, postage and tax. Here's the T-shirt on PayPal's own page: XL at $21, plus $4.50 postage.

spoken: Under the hood, it's the Payment Links API, Orders version two to read every payment back, and a signed PayPal webhook.
written: Under the hood: the Payment Links API, Orders v2 to read every payment back, and a signed PayPal webhook.

spoken: Now the proof. A test buyer pays through every new link in the PayPal sandbox, picking the dearest option. Then Last Button asks PayPal what was actually paid, and checks it against price, postage and tax, to the cent. Only then does a row turn green. The poster bundle: twelve dollars, three postage, ninety nine cents tax. Fifteen ninety nine, exactly.
written: Now the proof. A test buyer pays through every new link in the PayPal sandbox, picking the dearest option. Then Last Button asks PayPal what was actually paid, and checks it against price, postage and tax, to the cent. Only then does a row turn green. The poster bundle: $12, $3 postage, 99¢ tax. $15.99, exactly.

spoken: To swap them in, download the patched page, or paste one line into your template. There's product markup too, so A I shopping agents can find a working checkout.
written: To swap them in, download the patched page, or paste one line into your template. There's product markup too, so AI shopping agents can find a working checkout.

spoken: On our four test sites every field was right, but we wrote those sites ourselves. Live, seven of seven payments matched.
written: On our four test sites every field was right, but we wrote those sites ourselves. Live, 7 of 7 payments matched.

spoken: Last Button. Built with PayPal and Gemini.
written: Last Button. Built with PayPal and Gemini.
